source: Holding [b=RDUp] while in the air will break enemy defenses from above with a Critical Attack
translation: 在空中按住 [b=RDUp]，可从上方发动重击，击破敌人的防御

source: You cannot connect to EA Servers because your account has been deactivated or banned.\n
translation: 你的账户已被停用或封禁，无法连接 EA 服务器。\n

source: Requires {n}
translation: 需要 {n}

source: You have found a new relic\n\n [c=DARK_RED] {s} [c=RESET]
translation: 你找到了一件新圣物\n\n [c=DARK_RED] {s} [c=RESET]

source: Press [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] to initiate a Quick Combo
translation: 按 [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] [b=RDLeft] 发动快速连击

source: New torments I behold, and new tormented around me, \nwhichever way I move
translation: 我看见新的苦刑，也看见周围新受苦的亡魂，\n无论我走向何方

source: Consume within thyself \nwith thine own rage
translation: 让你自己的怒火\n将你吞噬吧

source: The city draweth near whose name is \nDis, with the grave citizens, \nwith the great throng
translation: 那名为狄斯的城已近在眼前，\n城中住着沉重的亡魂，\n聚集着无数受罚者

source: O banished out of Heaven, \npeople despised! Whence is this \narrogance within you couched?
translation: 啊，被逐出天国、\n遭人唾弃的众生！你们心中的\n这份狂妄从何而来？

source: Justice divine doth spite them \nwith its hammer
translation: 神圣的正义挥动铁锤，\n向他们降下惩罚

source: Me it behoves to show him the dark \nvalley; necessity, and not delight, \nimpels us
translation: 我必须带他走过幽暗的\n山谷；驱使我们的乃是必需，\n而非乐趣

source: Ah, savage company! But in the church \nwith saints, and in the tavern \nwith the gluttons!
translation: 啊，这群野蛮的同伴！但在教堂里，\n便与圣徒为伍；在酒馆里，\n便与饕客同行！

source: Kill all enemies\n
translation: 消灭所有敌人\n

source: You have unlocked your first level of Unholy \nPunish the Damned and enemies to unlock more levels of Unholy \nAbsolve the Damned and enemies to unlock Holy
translation: 你已解锁邪恶等级的第一级\n惩罚受诅咒者与敌人，可解锁更多邪恶等级\n救赎受诅咒者与敌人，可解锁神圣等级

source: Holding [b=RDRight] longer will increase the damage from Divine Force when released
translation: 按住 [b=RDRight] 的时间越长，释放神圣之力时造成的伤害越高

source: Dante's aerial attack damage is increased. \nLvl 1: 10%, Lvl 2: 15%, Lvl 3: 20%
translation: 提高但丁的空中攻击伤害。\n1 级：10%，2 级：15%，3 级：20%

source: Deleting %1. Please don't turn off your Xbox 360 console.\n
translation: 正在删除 %1。请勿关闭 Xbox 360 主机。\n

source: Hold [b=RSTop] to slide down
translation: 按住 [b=RSTop] 向下滑行

source: Pressing [b=LSBottom] + [b=RDDown] will execute a high frequency Focus Attack combo
translation: 按 [b=LSBottom] + [b=RDDown] 发动高频集中攻击连招

source: Move [b=LStick] in any direction to climb the Damned \nPress [b=RDDown] to jump and [b=RSTop] to slide
translation: 向任意方向推动 [b=LStick]，攀爬受诅咒者\n按 [b=RDDown] 跳跃，按 [b=RSTop] 滑行

source: Use [b=Lstick] to rotate the symbol wheel and change the symbols inside the catchers
translation: 使用 [b=Lstick] 转动符号轮，改变卡槽中的符号

source: Press [b=RDRight] after countering to initiate a Critical Attack that sends enemies flying
translation: 格挡反击后按 [b=RDRight]，发动将敌人击飞的重击

source: Press [b=LSBottom] just before an enemy attack to counter. Press [b=RDLeft] or [b=RDUp] after countering to counter attack
translation: 在敌人攻击命中前按 [b=LSBottom] 招架。招架后按 [b=RDLeft] 或 [b=RDUp] 发动反击

source: Holding  and releasing [b=RDRight] while in the air will launch enemies into the air with divine might
translation: 在空中按住并松开 [b=RDRight]，以神圣之力将敌人击至空中

source: Press [b=RDDown] once to jump \nPress [b=RDDown] again in mid-air to double-jump
translation: 按一次 [b=RDDown] 跳跃\n在空中再次按 [b=RDDown] 进行二段跳

source: Increases the damage of all Scythe attacks and abilities. \nLvl 1: 10%, Lvl 2: 15%, Lvl 3: 20%
translation: 提高所有镰刀攻击与技能的伤害。\n1 级：10%，2 级：15%，3 级：20%

source: Move [b=LStick] down and press [b=RDDown] to drop down
translation: 向下推动 [b=LStick] 并按 [b=RDDown]，向下落去

source: Press [b=RDLeft] to swing fists \n Press [b=RDUp] to stomp
translation: 按 [b=RDLeft] 挥拳\n 按 [b=RDUp] 踩踏

source: Press and hold [b=RDRight] to breathe fire \nWhile holding [b=RDRight] use the [b=LStick] to aim
translation: 按住 [b=RDRight] 喷火\n按住 [b=RDRight] 时，使用 [b=LStick] 瞄准

source: Push Up on the [b=LStick] to pull up \nPush Down on the [b=LStick] or press [b=RDDown] to drop
translation: 向上推动 [b=LStick] 翻上边缘\n向下推动 [b=LStick] 或按 [b=RDDown] 松手下落

source: Move Left or Right on the [b=LStick] to shimmy
translation: 向左或向右推动 [b=LStick]，沿边缘横向移动

source: Are you sure you want to overwrite %1 on storage device %2?
translation: 确定要将 %1 覆盖到存储设备 %2 上吗？

source: Chance to perform a Critical Strike on any attack is increased. Damage increases by 15% and enemies are knocked down when a Critical Strike is landed. \nLvl 1: 10%, Lvl 2: 15%, Lvl 3: 20%
translation: 提高任意攻击触发暴击的几率。暴击造成的伤害提高 15%，并将敌人击倒。\n1 级：10%，2 级：15%，3 级：20%

source: Dante's ranged attack and projectile damage is increased. \nLvl 1: 10%, Lvl 2: 15%, Lvl 3: 20%
translation: 提高但丁的远程攻击与投射物伤害。\n1 级：10%，2 级：15%，3 级：20%

source: Pressing [b=LSBottom] + [b=RDLeft] during Vile Tornado will send enemies flying with a Critical Attack
translation: 在邪恶旋风期间按 [b=LSBottom] + [b=RDLeft]，发动重击将敌人击飞

source: Use [b=LStick] to move up and down \nHold [b=RSTop] to build momentum and swing
translation: 使用 [b=LStick] 上下移动\n按住 [b=RSTop] 积蓄动量并摆荡

source: Press [b=RDDown] while swinging to jump off \nPress [b=RDDown] again to jump a second time
translation: 摆荡时按 [b=RDDown] 跳离\n再次按 [b=RDDown] 进行二段跳

source: Remember, when Dante's cross lights up, press [b=RDLeft]
translation: 记住，当但丁的十字架亮起时，按 [b=RDLeft]

source: Hold down [b=LSTop] and press [b=RDRight], [b=RDUp], [b=RDLeft], or [b=RDDown] to perform a magic attack
translation: 按住 [b=LSTop]，再按 [b=RDRight]、[b=RDUp]、[b=RDLeft] 或 [b=RDDown] 施放魔法

translation: 下载内容 %1 已损坏，无法使用。请重新下载，以再次启用 %1。

source: You found a silver Judas Coin \nCollect 30 pieces of silver for soul rewards
translation: 你找到了一枚犹大银币\n收集 30 枚银币可获得灵魂奖励

translation: 扣动 [b=LSBottom] 格挡攻击

translation: 每次成功命中都会提高救赎能量的积累速度。\n1 级：10%，2 级：20%，3 级：30%

source: Pull [b=RSBottom] to grab enemies \nPress [b=RDLeft] to Punish or [b=RDRight] to Absolve
translation: 扣动 [b=RSBottom] 抓取敌人\n按 [b=RDLeft] 惩罚，或按 [b=RDRight] 救赎

source: Virgil has gifted you with your first Holy Magic, Righteous Path \nPress and Hold [b=LSTop] and then press [b=RDDown]
translation: 维吉尔赠予了你第一个神圣魔法：正义之路\n按住 [b=LSTop]，再按 [b=RDDown]

source: Righteous Path requires purple mana. \nGet mana from fountains and killing enemies.\n
translation: 正义之路需要消耗紫色魔力。\n可从泉水或消灭敌人处获得魔力。\n

source: Press [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] to initiate a Fierce Combo that knocks enemies to the ground and breaks their blocks
translation: 按 [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] [b=RDUp] 发动猛烈连击，将敌人击倒并击破格挡

source: Equip relics to modify stats and abilities.\nEquipped relics will upgrade as you collect souls.
translation: 装备圣物可改变属性与能力。\n收集灵魂时，已装备的圣物也会升级。

source: Challenge: SUCCESS!! \nBonus: SUCCESS!!\n
translation: 挑战：成功！！\n额外目标：成功！！\n

source: Press [b=RDRight] to breathe fire \nPull [b=RSBottom] to grab enemies

You've found a relic 
Press [b=Start] and slot these in your cross

translation:
你找到了一件圣物
按 [b=Start]，将圣物镶嵌在十字架上
